knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(gsm.kri)
library(gt)

# `params$dfMetrics` is the family-granular CTAS audit
# (`ctas_<parameter_category_3>_<parameter_category_2>`); every join in the
# report needs the field-level scheme (`ctas_<parameter_category_2>`) that
# `Summarize_CTAS()` emits, so collapse and dedupe here. The full audit
# stays available for the Metric Details table below.
dfMetricsPruned <- params$dfMetrics
if ("parameter_category_2" %in% names(dfMetricsPruned)) {
  dfMetricsPruned$MetricID <- paste0("ctas_", dfMetricsPruned$parameter_category_2)
}
dfMetricsPruned <- dfMetricsPruned[
  dfMetricsPruned$MetricID %in% unique(params$dfResults$MetricID), ,
  drop = FALSE
]
dfMetricsPruned <- dfMetricsPruned[!duplicated(dfMetricsPruned$MetricID), , drop = FALSE]

setup <- Report_Setup(
  dfResults = params$dfResults,
  dfMetrics = dfMetricsPruned,
  dfGroups = params$dfGroups
)

```

<div> `r setup$amber_kris` Amber CTAS metrics </div>

::: gsm-overview-table


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results = 'asis'}
# subset data on latest snapshot date
dfResults_current <- FilterByLatestSnapshotDate(params$dfResults)

GroupOverViz <- Widget_GroupOverview(
  dfResults = dfResults_current,
  dfMetrics = dfMetricsPruned,
  dfGroups = params$dfGroups,
  strGroupLevel = setup$GroupLevel,
  strGroupSubset = switch(setup$GroupLevel,
    Site = 'red',
    'all'
  ),
  strGroupLabelKey = switch(setup$GroupLevel,
    Site = 'InvestigatorLastName',
    NULL
  )
)

overview_viz <- list(groupOverview = GroupOverViz)

# Add FlagOverTime Table if dfResults contains delta data
if (any(grepl("_Change", names(params$dfResults)))) {
  intSnapshots <- 12L # consider adding this as a parameter
  strSnapshotDates <- unique(params$dfResults$SnapshotDate) %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
    head(intSnapshots)

  # Only include risk signals flagged at the most recent snapshot and the 12 most recent snapshots.
  dfResultsFlagged <- params$dfResults %>%
    FilterByFlags(bCurrentlyFlagged = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$SnapshotDate %in% strSnapshotDates
    )

  overview_viz$flagOverTime <- Widget_FlagOverTime(
    dfResults = dfResultsFlagged,
    dfMetrics = dfMetricsPruned,
    strGroupLevel = setup$GroupLevel,
    strFootnote = glue::glue(
      "Table displays the {
        length(strSnapshotDates)
      } most recent snapshots and only includes risk signals flagged in the most recent snapshot."
    ),
    bExcludeEver = TRUE
  )
}

Report_MetricCharts(overview_viz)
```

:::

```{r, echo=FALSE, results = 'asis'}

Report_OverviewText(
  lSetup = setup,
  dfResults = dfResults_current,
  lStudy = setup$lStudy
)


```



```{r flag-change-html, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

# Add custom GroupLabel and MetricLabel values to dfResults
dfResults_delta <- dfResults_current %>%         
  dplyr::left_join(dfMetricsPruned %>% dplyr::select(MetricID, MetricName=Metric), 
                   by = "MetricID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MetricLabel = dplyr::coalesce(MetricName, MetricID)) %>%
  add_Groups_metadata(
    params$dfGroups,
    setup$GroupLevel,
    setup$GroupLabelKey
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GroupLabel = paste0(GroupID," (",.data[[setup$GroupLabelKey]],")"))

# Render a list of newly changed flags if deltas are included in dfResults
Report_FlagChange(dfResults = dfResults_delta)
```

## Results

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

vMetrics <- unique(params$dfResults$MetricID)

for (i in vMetrics) {
  lMetric <- dfMetricsPruned %>% dplyr::filter(MetricID == i) %>% as.list

  print(htmltools::h3(lMetric$Metric))
  
  Report_MetricCharts(
    lCharts = params$lCharts[[lMetric$MetricID]],
    strMetricID = lMetric$MetricID
  )
  
  print(htmltools::tags$br())

}

```

## Metric Details
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Full family-granular CTAS audit: one row per (field x metric family) with
# every CTAS parameter column from the metric YAMLs.
DT::datatable(
  params$dfMetrics,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = c("Buttons", "ColReorder"),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100, 250),
    dom = "Blfrtip",
    scrollX = TRUE,
    colReorder = TRUE,
    buttons = list(
      list(extend = "colvis", text = "Columns"),
      "copy", "csv", "excel", "pdf", "print"
    )
  )
)
```
